name: record_hypothesis
arguments: {"statement": "The Thr254Met substitution sits in the beta strand of the CD40L TNF homology domain at a trimer or CD40-contact face, and the bulkier Met side chain disrupts homotrimer packing and CD40 engagement, so the mutant subunit cannot form or hold a functional trimer and CD40 binding and signalling are lost.", "mechanism_class": "protein_interaction", "supports": ["E2", "E3", "E4", "E9", "E11", "E12", "E14", "E18", "E10"], "would_refute": "Thr254 side-chain atoms in the CD40-CD40L complex (3QD6) and in the trimer built from the AlphaFold model lie more than about 8 \u00c5 from any atom of the partner chain, and modelling Met at 254 leaves the trimer contact area and the CD40 interface unchanged within about 5%.", "starting_rank": 1, "rank_rationale": "Ranked first because the closest evidence for the homologous interface region is protein-interaction evidence: E10 (G257R, a neighbouring variant, not T254M) shows trimer-contact loss, E12 links X-HIGM CD40L mutations to impaired CD40 catch-bond signalling, and E14 shows mutant CD40L associates with wild-type in cells, which fits a trimer-disruption mechanism. Weakness: no study measures T254M itself (G1, G3), no curated partner interface is given for residue 254 (G5), and E9/E11 show residue 254 is observed but not shown to contact CD40. Missing: direct contact map of residue 254 in 3QD6 and a trimer-interface calculation."}

name: record_hypothesis
arguments: {"statement": "Thr254Met is a buried or strand-core substitution in the CD40L TNF homology domain that adds steric bulk and loses the Thr hydroxyl, so the beta-sandwich folds less stably, the protein is partly misfolded or degraded, and secretion and trimer assembly fall below the level needed for CD40 signalling.", "mechanism_class": "stability_folding", "supports": ["E3", "E4", "E5", "E6", "E7", "E8", "E15", "E9"], "would_refute": "In the AlphaFold model and in the 8 experimental structures, residue 254 has relative solvent accessibility above 50% and sits outside the strand core, and a stability predictor or Met-substituted model gives a folding energy change (\u0394\u0394G) with magnitude below 1 kcal/mol with no local backbone or pLDDT change.", "starting_rank": 2, "rank_rationale": "Ranked second: the in-silico predictors (E5 AlphaMissense 0.77, E8 EVE 0.76, E7 popEVE -5.2) and the strand annotation (E3) all support a damaging effect, but none of them says whether the damage is folding or interface loss, and E6 conservation is only moderate (0.63). E15 gives the AlphaFold model a mean pLDDT of 82.6, so local-fold confidence at 254 is not stated. Missing: per-residue pLDDT and solvent accessibility at 254, and any \u0394\u0394G measurement for T254M (G3, G4)."}
